commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
BRANCH=feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125
EXPECTED_MAIN=0b335324093de84056c5f79143a6bf25fbc1143e
EXPECTED_FEATURE=a9735ae967689190cb42eac8d41580493d7aba0b
test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
test "$(git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$BRANCH" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_FEATURE"
echo MAIN_UNCHANGED=true
CACHE="$HOME/.local/share/aicalls-qa"
ORIGINAL="$CACHE/2cd0010be02ae660ee27815328f4c32d44932623/previous.apk"
CURRENT="$CACHE/$EXPECTED_FEATURE/candidate.apk"
test -s "$ORIGINAL" && test -s "$CURRENT"
SIGNER="$(find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -name apksigner -type f | sort -V | tail -1)"
certificate() { "$SIGNER" verify --print-certs "$1" | sed -n 's/.*Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1; }
test "$(certificate "$ORIGINAL")" = fb07493cf97b0a84ec410f7f72f12938b7f9d47151546e15c049c49c27807b11
test "$(certificate "$CURRENT")" = "$(certificate "$ORIGINAL")"
PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery --serial RFCT70L7E8J)"
adbq() { adb -s "$SERIAL" "$@"; }
phone_idle() {
  local states mode
  states="$(adbq shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | tr -d '\r')"
  mode="$(adbq shell dumpsys audio | sed -n 's/.*Actual mode = \(MODE_[A-Z_]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')"
  [[ -n "$states" && -z "$(printf '%s\n' "$states" | grep -v '^0$' || true)" && "$mode" == MODE_NORMAL ]]
}
role_ok() { [[ "$(adbq shell cmd role get-role-holders --user 0 android.app.role.DIALER | tr -d '\r')" == "$PKG" ]]; }
package_path() {
  local paths
  paths="$(adbq shell pm path --user 0 "$PKG" | tr -d '\r')"
  [[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$paths" | grep -c '^package:')" == 1 ]]
  printf '%s\n' "$paths" | sed -n 's/^package://p'
}
hash() { shasum -a 256 "$1" | awk '{print $1}'; }
host_ready() {
  local response
  response="$(adbq shell content call --uri content://pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.gsmbinder --method status 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ "$response" == *host_registered=true* ]]
}
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-restore-original-XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
phone_idle && role_ok || { echo PHONE_NOT_IDLE_OR_ROLE_CHANGED; exit 50; }
adbq pull "$(package_path)" "$WORK/before.apk" >/dev/null
if [[ "$(hash "$WORK/before.apk")" == "$(hash "$ORIGINAL")" ]]; then
  echo ORIGINAL_ALREADY_INSTALLED=true
elif [[ "$(hash "$WORK/before.apk")" == "$(hash "$CURRENT")" ]]; then
  echo STAGE=RESTORE_EXACT_PRE_TASK_APK
  phone_idle && role_ok
  adbq install --no-streaming -r "$ORIGINAL"
else
  echo UNKNOWN_INSTALLED_APK_REFUSED; exit 51
fi
phone_idle && role_ok
adbq pull "$(package_path)" "$WORK/after.apk" >/dev/null
test "$(hash "$WORK/after.apk")" = "$(hash "$ORIGINAL")"
echo ORIGINAL_APK_SHA256_MATCH=true
echo ORIGINAL_APK_RESTORED=true
echo PRODUCTION_ROLE_UNCHANGED=true
PACKAGES="$(adbq shell pm list packages --user 0 | tr -d '\r')"
printf '%s\n' "$PACKAGES" | grep -Fxq "package:$PKG"
if printf '%s\n' "$PACKAGES" | grep -Fxq "package:$PKG.s8lab"; then echo UNEXPECTED_LAB_INSTALLED; exit 52; fi
echo ONE_MAIN_APP=true
# A new provider instance after package replacement must not expose the QA endpoint.
QA_STATUS="$(adbq shell content call --uri content://pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.gsmbinder --method qa_status 2>&1 || true)"
if [[ "$QA_STATUS" == *armed=true* || "$QA_STATUS" == *armed=false* ]]; then echo NEW_QA_ENDPOINT_STILL_PRESENT; exit 53; fi
echo NEW_QA_ENDPOINT_REMOVED=true
if host_ready; then echo GSM_HOST_READY=true; else
  phone_idle && role_ok
  adbq shell 'APP=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; APK="$(pm path --user 0 "$APP" | sed -n "s/^package://p" | head -n 1)"; test -n "$APK" && test -r "$APK" || exit 7; CLASSPATH="$APK" nohup app_process /system/bin --nice-name=aicalls_gsm_binder pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.session.GsmShellBinderMediaHost pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &' >/dev/null
  for i in {1..25}; do if host_ready; then break; fi; sleep 1; done
  host_ready || { echo ORIGINAL_GSM_HOST_NOT_READY; exit 54; }
  echo GSM_HOST_READY=true
fi
phone_idle && role_ok
rm -f "$CACHE/one-time-stage/stage-20261126-v1.pem"
echo NO_CALLS_NO_DATA_CLEAR=true
echo STAGE=DELETE_REQUESTED_FEATURE_BRANCH
test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
test "$(git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$BRANCH" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_FEATURE"
git push --force-with-lease="refs/heads/$BRANCH:$EXPECTED_FEATURE" origin ":refs/heads/$BRANCH"
test -z "$(git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$BRANCH")"
echo REMOTE_FEATURE_BRANCH_DELETED=true
if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$BRANCH"; then
  if [[ "$(git rev-parse "refs/heads/$BRANCH")" = "$EXPECTED_FEATURE" ]] && ! git worktree list --porcelain | grep -Fxq "branch refs/heads/$BRANCH"; then
    git branch -D "$BRANCH"
    echo LOCAL_FEATURE_BRANCH_DELETED=true
  else
    echo LOCAL_FEATURE_BRANCH_RETAINED_DUE_TO_WORKTREE_OR_DIFFERENT_HEAD=true
  fi
else
  echo LOCAL_FEATURE_BRANCH_ABSENT=true
fi
test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
echo MAIN_UNCHANGED=true
echo ROLLBACK_COMPLETE=true
